NAME
telnet_msp_oob() - send an OOB MSP message

SYNOPSIS
void telnet_msp_oob(string);

DESCRIPTION
Support was added in FluffOS v2019.20220507. For a user connected through telnet, sends the sequence IAC SB TELOPT_MSP msg IAC SE, as documented at https://wiki.mudlet.org/w/Manual:Supported_Protocols#MSP

SEE ALSO
msp_enable(4)
